تهتلرت (form IIq)
# تَهَتْلَرْتُ (tahatlartu) /ta.hat.lar.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# تَهَتْلَرْتَ (tahatlarta) /ta.hat.lar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# تَهَتْلَرْتِ (tahatlarti) /ta.hat.lar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَهَتْلَرَ (tahatlara)
# تَهَتْلَرَتْ (tahatlarat) /ta.hat.la.rat/: t
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
